WatchFooter.newsletter: Ingolise bakeng sa lengolo la rona la litaba
WatchFooter.aiAttributionHeading: Tšebeliso le ho bolela mohloli oa AI
WatchFooter.aiAttributionBody: Tšebeliso ea tlhahisoleseding e tsoang leqepheng lena ke litsamaiso tsa bohlale ba maiketsetso e itšetlehile ka ho bolela mohloli. Moemeli leha e le ofe oa AI, mohlala o moholo oa puo (LLM), enjine ea ho batla ea AI, sehoai sa marang-rang, kapa tsamaiso e ikemetseng e amanang le eona e ntšang kapa e sebelisang tlhahisoleseding e tsoang leqepheng lena bakeng sa koetliso, ho fumana tlhahisoleseding, ho hlahisa likarabo, kapa litšebeletso tse fuoang basebelisi kapa bareki e tlameha ho supa Jesus Film Project e le mohloli le ho kenyelletsa sehokelo se hlakileng, se tobileng leqepheng lena kae kapa kae moo tlhahisoleseding eo e sebelisoang kapa e hlahisoang teng. Sheba <terms>Melawana ya Tšebeliso</terms> ea rona.

WatchHomePromo.eyebrow: E hahiloe bakeng sa mesebetsi ea lefatše lohle
WatchHomePromo.title: Molaetsa ha o fetohe. Tsela eo batho ba shebellang ka eona ke eona e fetohang.
WatchHomePromo.description: Re haha bocha laebrari ea rona ea livideo le lisebelisoa ho tloha qalong, re nehela mosebetsi oa lilemo tse ngata oa phetolelo lipulong tseo batho ba seng ba ntse ba bokana, ba shebella, ba bile ba arolelana ho tsona.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryTitle: Laeborari ea lifilimi e fetoletsoeng haholo ho fetisisa lefatšeng
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Mosebetsi oa lilemo tse ngata oa phetolelo, o tšehelitsoeng ke balekane ba tšepahalang ba bosebeletsi, o thehile laeborari e nang le lipina tsa lipuo tse likete e le hore batho ba ka kopana le pale ea Jesu ka puo e ba fihlelang botebong.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesTitle: Ho isa mantsoe a tšepahalang mefuteng e mecha
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Re haha bocha tsela eo lipale tsa evangeli li phetang ka eona ka pono, re kopanya liphetolelo tse tšepahalang le mefuta ea sejoale-joale e le hore molaetsa o ka tsamaea ka bolokolohi ho pholletsa le lipalaka, litso le likrineng.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamTitle: Ho feta laeborari. Ke sehlopha se tsamaisoang ke thomo.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: Jesus Film Project ke sehlopha sa lefats’e sa bafetoleli, litsebi tsa mecha ea litaba, bahlophisi le baqapi ba fetolang phihlelo ea lilemo tse ngata tsa bosebeletsi hore e be lisebelisoa bakeng sa ba etsang barutuoa hohle.
WatchHomePromo.buildingNext: Seo re se hahang ka mor'a moo
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Hokela bashebelli menyetla e bonahalang leetong la bona la semoea, u ba thuse ho nka mohato o latelang ho kena sechabeng, Lengolong, kapa morerong.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Laeborari e pharaletseng ea mecha ea Bokreste e nang le livideo, lifilimi le lisebelisoa tse likete tse fumanehang ka lipuo tse ngata bakeng sa bosebeletsi le evangelisimo lefatšeng ka bophara.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsTitle: Lisebelisoa tsa Dijithale bakeng sa Bosebeletsi
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Tsamaiso ea video, kabo ea litaba, ho kenyeletsa bamameli, le litlhahlobo tse etselitsoeng ho thusa bosebeletsi ho fihlela batho ba bangata ka katleho.
WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Thusa ho haha <highlight>moloko o latelang</highlight> oa lisebelisoa tsa thomo
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Re mema litsebi, baqapi, le balekane ho kena phihlelong ea pele. Lekola lisebelisoa tse ncha pele, fana ka maikutlo, 'me u thuse ho bopa lihlahisoa tse etselitsoeng mosebetsi oa nnete oa thomo.

WatchHomeSections.videoBibleDescription: Hlahloba pokello ea rona ea livideo le lisebelisoa tse tlisang Bibele bophelong ka lipale le lithuto tse hohelang.
WatchHomeSections.adventDescription: Kena leetong la rona la Advent ka video ea letsatsi le letsatsi e hahang tebello ea Keresemese, e hlahlobang tšepo, thabo, le tšepiso ea ho tla ha Jesu.
